title: Rich, Smoky Veggie Boston Baked Beans
ingredients: 3 × 400g cans borlotti beans, drained and rinsed
steps: In a large deep pan with a lid, fry onion in cooking spray until soft and lightly browned.
Remove from heat; pour in stock; add all remaining ingredients and stir well.
Pop lid on; bake in centre of oven for 1½ hours. After 1 hour, stir and remove lid for final 30 minutes.
notes: Add chopped sausage, smoked bacon or pancetta fried alongside the onion for a meat version.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
